text.en: Counter fee depends on the permitted period and is paid with a revenue stamp: 10,000 yen (3 months or less), 18,000 (over 3 up to 6 months), 25,000 (over 6 months up to under 1 year), 33,000 (1 year), 48,000 (over 1 year up to under 3 years), 64,000 (3 years up to under 5), 75,000 (5 years or more). Applications received by September 30, 2026 pay the old 6,000 yen. Reductions or exemptions may apply. The online fee differs (to be checked).
